Cost: 250eb (Premium) for a box of 10 Tri-Casings
Stack: 10

Adapter casings that merge different arrows, bullets, shells, or slugs into one round with all of their effects. If any merged type deals no damage, the round deals none, though its other effects still apply. The included jig loads 10 rounds as one Action; by hand it's an Action per round. Casings are single-use. Firing combined rounds treats the weapon as one quality tier lower (Poor Quality weapons are Destroyed, not beyond repair); quality-raising attachments still work from that lower base. Box of 10 Tri-Casings: each combines up to 3 ammo types.

Foundry notes:

  • Not loadable ammo: an adapter you apply to other rounds or grenades.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
